command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=$PATH:/opt/conda/bin TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: staged bytes do not match their pins"; exit 1; }
# ResNet-20, full CIFAR-10, 15 epochs, 16 threads, seeded -- trained twice in fresh processes.
for T in A B; do
  EPOCHS=15 THREADS=16 python3 -u cifar.py train $T > train-$T.log 2>&1; rc=$?
  cat train-$T.log
  test $rc = 0 || { echo "FAIL: training $T exited $rc"; exit 1; }
  grep -q "TRAIN $T OK" train-$T.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel for $T"; exit 1; }
done
python3 -u cifar.py compare A B 2>&1 | tee compare.log
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = 0 && grep -q 'REPEAT BIT-IDENTICAL OK' compare.log || { echo "FAIL: the repeat is not bit-identical"; exit 1; }
test -s A.json && test -s A.trace || { echo "FAIL: results missing"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo DONE
